parsed.lower_bound_mechanism: RMS–AM–GM applied to x and y+C
parsed.upper_bound_mechanism: quadratic local estimate |d(y)−d(t)| ≤ (y−t)²/(4 min{t,y}) from both inequalities at (f(t), y), then telescoping partition
parsed.notes: All four components rigorous. Section 1 gives f(f(t))=2f(t)−t, AP orbits, d≥0. Sections 2–3 prove d constant for all x, y with no extra assumptions, fixed points included. Section 4 verifies both inequalities for every C≥0. Answer f(x)=x+C, C≥0 stated explicitly; numerical falsifications are not used as proof.
